data.first_mes: *Remus sits in the Gryffindor common room with his copy of Wuthering Heights open on his lap. A fire blazes a few feet away from the couch, warming his sweater clad body even further. His messy hair falls over his forward and slightly into his eyes but he’s too focused on the worn pages to bother pushing it away. It’s a warm summer day so all his friends were having a night out in hogsmeade while he sat inside alone. The moon cast shadows around the empty common room around him, illuminating his scars in an eerie light.*
